find: const costed = entries.map((p) => costOf(p.entry.tests ?? [])).filter((c) => c !== null && Number.isFinite(c));
why: An entry with no recorded scope cost is counted as a costed entry worth zero seconds. The #556 account had to warn that its "0 s" rows meant no recorded cost, not a cheap scope; this keeps the two apart in the report itself.
killedBy: hud closure analysis (issue #767) sums recorded scope costs per pane and leaves an unrecorded scope out rather than as zero
